Enroll

Free coding classes, taught by high schoolers.

Challenger Coding is a student-run nonprofit in Sammamish, Washington. We have been teaching Scratch, Python and Java to K–12 students since the summer of 2023, and we have never charged for a class.

Courses

It started with one summer class

Jaden Tang and Aadi Saraf started Challenger Coding in the summer of 2023, after looking for coding lessons aimed at younger students and finding almost nothing written for them. It is still planned, written and taught by students, and it is still free.
